title: test(console): wait on the leave guard itself after a settings save, not on the bar
body:
Fixes #13317

## The race

The case "after a successful save the page is clean again: no prompt" in `SettingsView.leaveGuard-13163.test.tsx` waited for the unsaved bar (`settings-unsaved-count`) to go and then asserted, synchronously, that a `beforeunload` is not held. Those are two different moments:

- the bar goes in the **commit** that renders `setDraft({})` after the save resolves;
- the guard goes one step later, in the **passive effect** cleanup of `useRegisterUnsavedEdits` (app-shell's unsaved-edits seam), which removes the `beforeunload` and capture-phase `click` listeners.

The save settles after an `await`, outside `act()`, so the update renders on the default lane and react-dom 19.2.8 hands the passive flush to the scheduler as a task of its own (only sync-lane commits flush passive effects inline). When the commit task overruns the scheduler's 5ms frame budget, the scheduler yields, and RTL's `waitFor` (whose wrapper ends on a `setTimeout(0)`) can return before that task runs. The assertion then reads the still-registered guard: `expected true to be false`, the CI signature.

Product code is not changed: the release is one task after the bar disappears, before any paint a user could react to. What was wrong is the test, which waited on a stand-in for the thing it asserts. The fix waits on the guard itself (a `waitFor` around the `beforeunload` check), the same shape `discardGuard.test.tsx` in `plugin-form` already uses for its dirty case. The link listener is removed in the same uninstall, so the click assertion that follows needs no wait of its own.

## Measured

PM mechanism assumption 1 holds, with one correction: the draft reset is not late. The bar goes on time, and what lands later is the guard's release, in a passive effect. Assumption 2 holds: the diff from the base commit touches neither file, and the race is the test's own.

- **The gap, on an unloaded run (probe, not committed):** a MutationObserver that fires when the bar leaves the DOM read the guard **still held 20/20**. Right after `waitFor` returned it was released 20/20, which is why the file passes locally (5/5 reruns on the card, 1/1 here at the base commit, 12/12 tests).
- **Same probe with a slow machine modelled** (`performance.now` skewed +10ms per read, so React's scheduler yields after every task): right after `waitFor`, the guard was **still held 13/20**.
- **The real case, before and after, under that same load** (uncommitted copies of the file with the case repeated 20 times):
  - before (base commit): `Tests  10 failed | 21 passed (31)`, every failure `AssertionError: expected true to be false` at `expect(unload.defaultPrevented).toBe(false)` in that case; the file's other 11 cases are green;
  - after (this branch): `Tests  31 passed (31)`.
- **Ablation** (a mutation, run once and restored): with `useUnsavedLeaveGuard` registering unconditionally (`useRegisterUnsavedEdits(true, message)`), the fixed case goes red inside the new wait (`Tests  1 failed | 11 skipped`, `expected true to be false`). So the wait does not pass when the guard is never released. The mutation was applied through `ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `42a45f17ddd5` to `97ee57239286`, then restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Verification (head `42cc11c`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/`: `Test Files  236 passed (236)`, `Tests  2408 passed (2408)`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` 0 · `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` 0 · `pnpm check:new-line-citations` 0 · `pnpm check:control-bytes` 0 · `pnpm check:test-path-roots` 0 · `pnpm check:changeset-claims` 0 · `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` 0 · `eslint` on the changed file (console config) 0.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `type-check` for `@object-ui/console` exits 2 in this worktree because the workspace packages' `dist` is not built. Every error is module resolution or cascades from it, and the only error reported in the changed file is on its existing `@object-ui/i18n` import, a line this diff does not touch. CI's `type-check` and repository-wide `pnpm lint` decide these.

The changeset `.changeset/13317-settings-leaveguard-race.md` has an empty frontmatter: test-only, releases nothing (AGENTS.md section 9).

## Acceptance notes

- I surveyed the other suites that assert a `beforeunload` (`git grep -ln beforeunload` over tests). None of them checks a guard that is released after an awaited save while waiting on a DOM stand-in; their clean checks follow `act`-wrapped events or a pristine mount. No other instance of this shape was found.
